content.short: Stablecoin-first dollar banking alternative with cards.
content.description: Rizon is a stablecoin-first dollar banking app that gives people anywhere in the world a way to hold, spend, and move digital dollars. A Circle partner, it lets users store value in USDC, earn on balances, send money across borders, and spend with a card that converts stablecoins to fiat at the point of sale, using networks such as Ethereum and Solana under the hood. Rizon targets consumers in markets where access to stable US dollars and reliable banking is limited, wrapping stablecoin infrastructure in a simple, familiar mobile banking experience rather than a crypto-trading interface. By making digital dollars easy to save and spend globally, Rizon positions itself among the new wave of stablecoin-powered neobanks focused on dollar access for everyday users.
content.meta: Rizon is a stablecoin-first dollar banking app with a card for global users. Discover Rizon and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
